digest.en: China's pushback against US sanctions dominates the headlines, with Beijing signaling a tougher era for global business. Meanwhile, Vladimir Putin's comments on the Ukraine war are drawing attention, with the Russian leader claiming the conflict is winding down despite Ukrainian battlefield gains. Greece's controlled blast of mystery naval drone explosives adds to the regional tensions.
digest.hi: 联合 राष्ट्र में ईरान पर कार्रवाई की मांग की गई है क्योंकि पिछले 24 घंटे से एक भी जहाज होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य से नहीं गुजरा है। पीएम मोदी आज कर्नाटक-तेलंगाना के दौरे पर हैं और हैदराबाद में ₹9400 करोड़ के विकास परियोजनाओं की सौगात देंगे। त्रिनिदाद में भारतीय केंद्र का आगाज हुआ है।

articles.title: China’s pushback against US sanctions signals tougher era for global business
articles.summary: China invoked its Blocking Rules to counter US sanctions, marking a shift from rhetoric to enforcement, affecting companies caught between conflicting legal systems. China has invoked its “Blocking Rules” for the first time to counter US sanctions, marking a shift from rhetoric to enforcement, leaving companies caught between conflicting legal systems.

articles.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
articles.summary: Israeli strikes killed 39 people in Lebanon, despite a ceasefire deal announced last month. Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

articles.title: Palestinian family says settlers forced them to exhume father’s body
articles.summary: A Palestinian family in Jenin was forced to exhume their father's body by Israeli settlers. A Palestinian family in Jenin says Israeli settlers forced them to exhume their father hours after his funeral.

articles.title: Three police officers killed in car bomb attack in northwest Pakistan
articles.summary: A car bomb attack in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killed three police officers. Bomber and several fighters detonate explosives-laden vehicle near security post in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Three police officers killed in car bomb attack in northwest Pakistan.

articles.title: Putin says Ukraine war winding down, blasts West for backing Kyiv
articles.summary: Russian President Putin stated the Ukraine war is winding down, criticizing the West for supporting Ukraine. He also expressed a willingness to meet Ukrainian President Zelenskyy, but only after conditions for a potential peace agreement are met.

articles.title: Putin says Ukraine war likely to end soon - despite Ukrainian battlefield gains
articles.summary: President Vladimir Putin said the Ukraine war is likely to end soon, despite Ukrainian battlefield gains. President Vladimir Putin has said he believes the Ukraine war is coming to an end.

articles.title: Israeli settlers force Palestinian family to exhume and rebury their father
articles.summary: Israeli settlers forced a Palestinian family to exhume and rebury their father in the West Bank. The UN condemned the confrontation as dehumanising. UN condemns confrontation in occupied West Bank as 'appalling and emblematic of the dehumanisation of Palestinians'.

articles.title: Putin says he thinks Ukraine war is 'coming to an end'
articles.summary: Putin said the Ukraine war is coming to an end as a three-day ceasefire began. Moscow and Kyiv are observing the truce. The Russian president made the remarks as Moscow and Kyiv observe a three-day ceasefire in their four-year conflict.

articles.title: Vladimir Putin On Russia's War With Ukraine
articles.summary: Putin stated Russia's war with Ukraine needs European governments to make the first move. The Kremlin made this statement last week. The Kremlin said last week that it was for European governments to make the first move.

articles.title: Man City beat Brentford to close gap to Arsenal to two points in title race
articles.summary: Manchester City beat Brentford with three second-half goals. This closes the gap to Arsenal to two points in the title race. Manchester City score three in the second half of their Premier League match against Brentford to maintain title hopes.

articles.title: All Aboard Hantavirus-Hit Ship 'High-Risk Contact', Must Be Monitored: WHO
articles.summary: The WHO declared all aboard a hantavirus-hit ship as high-risk contacts. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is heading to Tenerife. All Aboard Hantavirus-Hit Ship 'High-Risk Contact', Must Be Monitored: WHO.

articles.title: Greece conducts controlled blast of mystery naval drone explosives
articles.summary: Greek authorities conducted a controlled explosion of a naval drone found in a cave by fishermen. The unmanned vessel, suspected to be of Ukrainian origin, was discovered on Thursday. The unmanned vessel, suspected to be of Ukrainian origin, was found by fishermen in a cave on Thursday.

articles.title: Indian Sailor Dies, 4 Injured After Boat Catches Fire, Sinks Near Hormuz
articles.summary: An Indian sailor died and four others were injured when their boat caught fire and sank near Hormuz. The cause of the fire has not been determined yet. The exact cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained.

articles.title: UN mission in Democratic Republic of Congo warns of wave of attacks in east
articles.summary: The UN mission in Democratic Republic of Congo warns of attacks in the east. The mineral-rich eastern DRC has been plagued for three decades by conflict involving various armed groups, militia and army troops.

articles.title: Israeli drone strikes near Beirut kill four; southern airstrikes claim at least 13 lives
articles.summary: Israeli drone strikes near Beirut killed four people and southern airstrikes killed at least 13. The Israeli military said Hezbollah fired explosive drones into Israel near the border with Lebanon adding that three soldiers were wounded, one of them seriously, in one of the attacks.

articles.title: Plane hits and kills pedestrian during takeoff at Denver airport
articles.summary: Denver International Airport reported a plane struck and killed a pedestrian during takeoff at 11:19 p. m. on May 9. The incident involved Frontier Flight 4345, according to the airport's statement.

articles.title: Magyar sworn in as Hungary’s prime minister on promises of change
articles.summary: Peter Magyar was sworn in as Hungary's prime minister, promising change. He faces a tight deadline to secure billions of euros in suspended European Union funding to boost the economy and stabilize public finances.

articles.title: Army is fighting 'aggressive' NATO-backed force: Putin in Victory Day speech
articles.summary: Russian President Putin said the army is fighting an "aggressive" NATO-backed force in a Victory Day speech. The parade was scaled back, with no military hardware on display and limited foreign dignitaries in attendance.

articles.title: U.K. PM Starmer turns to Labour Party grandees after tough local election verdict
articles.summary: UK PM Starmer appoints Labour Party grandees, including former PM Gordon Brown, to boost security and resilience. On the appointment of the two Labour Party grandees, Mr. Starmer said that as Britain’s longest-serving chancellor, former PM Gordon Brown is well placed to work with international allies to boost the country’s security and resilience.

articles.title: Frontier plane kills pedestrian during takeoff, passengers evacuated after engine fire
articles.summary: A Frontier plane killed a pedestrian during takeoff when its engine caught fire, prompting an evacuation of passengers. Details of the incident are emerging. Frontier plane kills pedestrian during takeoff, passengers evacuated after engine fire.

articles.title: Peter Magyar Takes Over as Hungary’s Leader From Viktor Orban
articles.summary: Peter Magyar succeeded Viktor Orban as Hungary's leader, winning a landslide election. He now faces the challenge of dismantling Orban's "illiberal democracy" and addressing the country's economic and financial issues.
